title: Poetry
note: Quiet moral reckoning on guilt, beauty, and aging; deeply integrated form.

title: La La Land
note: Craftful musical revival; bittersweet ending lingers but nostalgia courts pastiche.

title: Seven Samurai
note: Foundational action grammar; humane class drama, inexhaustible craft and rhythm.

title: In the Mood for Love
note: Restraint as form; ravishing mood of longing that returns for years.

title: Parasite
note: Tight class allegory, precise tonal control; broadly legible yet durable.

title: City Lights
note: Final recognition shot is indelible; comedy and pathos perfectly fused.

title: Spirited Away
note: Imaginative coming-of-age; dense, hand-drawn world that deepens on rewatch.

title: The Godfather
note: American tragedy of power and family; controlled, monumental classical form.

title: 12 Angry Men
note: Masterful single-room dialectic on doubt and justice; slightly schematic.

title: A Separation
note: Moral complexity without villains; truth, class, and gender finely balanced.

title: Portrait of a Lady on Fire
note: Gaze and memory as form; painterly, restrained, lingering romance.

title: Moonlight
note: Triptych of identity and tenderness; sensuous color, genuinely lingering.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
note: Reorganizes cinematic time and scale; cosmic, austere, perceptually transformative.

title: The Tree of Life
note: Cosmic-to-domestic grace; elliptical form genuinely divides informed viewers.

title: Mulholland Drive
note: Dream-logic Hollywood nightmare; rewards rewatch, formally radical and controlled.

title: Synecdoche, New York
note: Vertiginous meditation on life, art, death; ambitious, sprawling, divisive.

title: Jeanne Dielman
note: Duration as feminist form; radical real-time domesticity reorganizes attention.

title: Antichrist
note: Grief and misogyny rendered as ordeal; striking yet provocatively unstable.

title: Holy Motors
note: Elegy for performance and cinema; protean, inventive, willfully unclassifiable.

title: Uncut Gems
note: Relentless anxiety machine; immersive craft, thin beneath the propulsion.

title: Beau Is Afraid
note: Maximalist Freudian odyssey; ambitious sprawl strains control, sharply divisive.

title: Close-Up
note: Blurs document and fiction; profound inquiry into cinema, identity, empathy.

title: Enemy
note: Doppelganger dread as control study; cryptic, sickly-yellow, rewards decoding.

title: Climax
note: Hypnotic descent into chaos; bravura camera, provocation outpaces substance.

title: Batman Returns
note: Gothic auteur blockbuster; expressive design, narrative incoherence, oddly durable.

title: Top Gun: Maverick
note: Superb practical action craft; emotionally legible but ideologically safe spectacle.

title: Ocean's Eleven
note: Effortless heist craft and cool; pleasurable, durable rewatch, low ambition.

title: Ant-Man
note: Competent franchise filler; pleasant, formulaic, evaporates after viewing.

title: John Wick
note: Lucid choreographed gun-fu; coherent world-building, stylish, genuinely rewatchable.

title: Crazy Rich Asians
note: Glossy crowd-pleasing rom-com; cultural visibility, conventional and safely engineered.

title: The Hangover
note: Sharp comic engine; broadly enjoyable, crude, durably quotable but slight.

title: Jurassic World
note: Nostalgia-mining spectacle; weightless CGI, self-aware yet hollow franchise reboot.

title: Knives Out
note: Clever, well-built whodunit; satirical bite, conventional under polished surface.

title: The Intouchables
note: Warm crowd-pleaser; emotionally effective but tidy, sentimental, ethically simplified.

title: Free Guy
note: Bright high-concept comedy; brand-laden, agreeable, conceptually shallow and disposable.

title: Babylon
note: Maximalist Hollywood epic; bravura excess outruns its subject, fiercely divisive.

title: Cloud Atlas
note: Ambitious interwoven epic; earnest sprawl, uneven control, sharply polarizing.

title: The Counselor
note: Nihilist McCarthy dialogue piece; bleak, talky, fascinatingly love-or-hate failure.

title: Joker
note: Scorsese-pastiche character study; potent lead, derivative form, intensely debated.

title: Don't Look Up
note: Blunt climate satire; obvious targets, smug delivery, broadly polarizing.

title: Star Wars: The Last Jedi
note: Subversive franchise entry; bold swings, tonal unevenness, fandom-splitting reception.

title: Sucker Punch
note: Empty meta-spectacle; ostentatious style detached from incoherent feminist pretext.

title: Spring Breakers
note: Neon hedonist critique; hypnotic, repetitive form genuinely splits serious viewers.

title: The Fountain
note: Earnest mortality triptych; visually rich, overreaching, love-or-hate cosmic sincerity.

title: Southland Tales
note: Sprawling apocalyptic satire; overstuffed, incoherent ambition, notoriously divisive misfire.

title: Suicide Squad
note: Incoherent committee blockbuster; chaotic edit, soundtrack pandering, hollow and disposable.

title: Vox Lux
note: Fame-and-violence portrait; formally bold, chilly, structurally uneven and divisive.

title: Avatar: The Way of Water
note: Technical waterscape marvel; immersive craft, thin story, spectacle exceeds substance.

title: Mamma Mia!
note: Exuberant jukebox confection; infectious yet slapdash, unabashedly disposable crowd-pleaser.

title: Now You See Me
note: Slick twist-driven caper; hollow misdirection, glossy, cheats its own premise.
